prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web app composition comp, 1440x1024
Primary request: Design the authenticated applicant dashboard for a Hackathons @ Berkeley multi-role portal in the pinned ‘Run of Show’ event-operations-binder identity.
Structure: a compact Berkeley-blue top mast spans the page with event identity, utility actions, and four hanging credential tabs reading HACKER, JUDGE, MENTOR, VOLUNTEER. Below, make a bold horizontal run-of-show strip the focal element: numbered cues 01 PROFILE, 02 EXPERIENCE, 03 LOGISTICS, 04 REVIEW, with the first two stamped complete and ‘03 LOGISTICS’ active. Under the strip, a wide editorial work sheet contains ‘Complete your hacker application’, 72% progress, two next required fields, and the single primary action ‘Resume at logistics’. A narrow left margin holds a clipped attendee credential for ‘Maya Chen’; a right margin lists ‘Up next’ deadlines and team-matching availability. Lower rows preview submitted role applications and event operations.
Visual world: sophisticated event production desk translated into semantic web UI. Berkeley blue #3D68BB, ink navy #0A2457, cool white paper #F5F7FB, Ddoski gold #CA841D, brown #AB5E18, restrained coral #E68A6D. Crisp rules, binder indexing, utility stamps, tab cuts; Space Grotesk-like headings, Karla-like body, Space Mono operational labels. A tiny Ddoski line illustration can act as a cue marker.
Composition: one dominant process strip with quiet supporting regions, high information density without clutter, unmistakable navigation and next action, accessible contrast.
Constraints: usable web application screenshot, never a poster or literal photographed desk; no generic dashboard cards, no glass, no gradients, no neon, no huge headline, no excessive pills, no watermark.
